t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : Try (a man) and you will hate him.

Al-Sayyid al-Radi says; Some people say this saying is of the Prophet (p.b.u.h.) a.h.p.), but what confirms that it is the saying of Amir al-Mu'minin (p.b.u.h.), is the statement related by Tha lab from Ibn al-A rabi namely that (Caliph) al-Ma'mun said :"If Ali had not said ukhbur taqlihi' (Try a man and youwill hate him)," I would have said, "aqlihi takhbur (Hate a man in order to try him)."
